findings.why: HB-620 is on PRG-Y, a Nordhavn program. Moving it from Fonderia Dora to Fonderia Pellice is a change of source. Nordhavn's written approval (PPAP resubmission) is needed before the first shipment. No Nordhavn approval is in the documents. The internal ASL approval APR-011 does not replace it. The change board minutes (MTG-2026-09-15) only say the move will happen once the audit and PPAP are through.
